item.tib: bder gshegs rig 'dzin dgongs pa 'dus pa gsang ba sum dril gyi rtsa ba'i rgyud mchog rin chen gter mdzod
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan gar dbang rat+na gling pa'am/ ye shes g.yung drung bstan pa'i nyi ma 'chi med brdul shugs rol ba rtsal gyis ang+gir zhes chu sprel rta pa zla ba'i dkar phyogs rdzogs pa gsum par rgyal ba dmu sras mgon po sku 'khrungs pa'i sangs rgyas dus chen skabs tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi byin gyis rlabs pa'i gnas chen dbal bon ru lag shel ri phyugs mo'i g.yas phyogs brag ri tshe bum 'dra ba'i gong ngo mtshar zla gam phug pa'i chu srin gre ba nas gter du spyan drangs shing slar lo gcig dang zla ba gsum gyi bka' rgya grol mtshams bstan pa'i rgyud 'dzin g.yung drung bstan pa 'brug grags bsod nams dpal bzang po gtsos bla grwa du ma nas rang gi bka' gter ma rnams mthar thon dgos pa'i bskal ma yang nan mdzad pa/ nye bar o rgyan bde chen gling pa'i rgyud 'dzin rgyas sras pad+ma 'phrin las dang / bla chen dran pa'i thugs spral rig 'dzin pad+ma bdud 'dul gyi yang srid tshe dbang yid bzhin dang*/ 'od ldan mkha' 'gro'i rnam rol Dak+ki bkra shis dpal sgron bcas lhan rgyas nas lha rdzas dri med kyis mtshams sbyar te de bzhin bka' yis bskul bzhin chu bya sa ga zla ba'i 'phel phyogs bzang po gnyis pa'i nyin bcom ldan thub pa'i dbang po sku 'khrungs pa'i dus tshes su shog ser bod yig tu zhal bshus te drung yig tshul khrims blo ldan nas sam b+ho Tar sor rtser myur du bskran te yig ge dang po'i byed po shel bla tshe dpag rgya mtshos bris pa'i dge des 'chi med yab sras gsum gyi bstan pa rin po che 'dzam gling phyogs bcu kun du dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
